scope: Full FLEURS Turkish source-only ASR and exact-transcript-group retrieval; not QA or paraphrase robustness.

asr.timing_scope: Historical synchronized model-generation time for 743 fresh transcripts; excludes feature preparation and is not full pipeline wall time.

audio_coverage.coverage_evidence: All source media hashes, cache identities/transcripts, WAV sample counts and retained feature-frame counts checked.

wer.normalization: NFKC; Turkish I/İ case mapping; casefold; Unicode punctuation to spaces; whitespace
wer.independent_recalculation: Full-matrix weighted edit alignment and backtracking, without calling production WER scorer.
wer.terminology: 1 - WER is sometimes called word accuracy; it is not semantic or answer accuracy.
wer.aggregation: Corpus word-weighted rate; references used post hoc for all 743 recordings.

metric_definitions.hit@5: At least one recording from the exact transcript group appears in the top five.
metric_definitions.recall@5: Mean fraction of all relevant group recordings retrieved in the top five.
metric_definitions.ndcg@10: Graded normalized discounted gain at ten; all FLEURS positive grades equal one.

original_native_comparison.interpretation: Same logical native benchmark repeated under the ASR-view dataset identity; freshly encoded audio, not a cache reuse or independent benchmark.

grouping.description: Declared transcript groups are verified against every positive recording's group_id; shared recordings and transcript groups connect queries.
grouping.resampling_assumption: Identified source components are treated as exchangeable resampling units; unrecorded cross-component dependencies may remain.

paired_analysis.caveat: Unadjusted exploratory source-group intervals. Transcript groups do not establish independence from shared speakers or topics; comparisons use the same ceiling-prone fixed-gallery task.

limitations: Queries are official normalized transcript groups, not independently authored semantic paraphrases.
Perfect retrieval does not imply perfect ASR, general speech understanding or question-answering accuracy.
1 - WER is not semantic or answer accuracy; insertions are included and WER can exceed one.
All 31 combinations share the same gallery and queries, so their results are not independent benchmark replications.
ASR WER and retrieval have different denominators: 743 recordings and 13,233 reference words versus 329 grouped retrieval queries.
